# Hanzo

> Hanzo OS is the operating system for agentic companies.

Hanzo OS unifies Enso, AI coworkers, secure execution, company data, full-stack
observability and the cloud beneath them in one open system. Four layers —
company, intelligence, execution, infrastructure — with learning and governance
cutting across all of them.

Run Hanzo OS on Hanzo Cloud or your own infrastructure.

Enso is the intelligence layer: one endpoint that reads the objective, applies
your policies and puts the right model behind the work. Zen is the open-weight
family. Both run beside 500+ models on the same endpoint and the same key.

Hanzo AI Inc, Techstars '17.

## About
Hanzo AI (Techstars '17) trains its own models and operates the infrastructure
that serves them. Two model families are ours — enso and Zen — and they run on
Hanzo Cloud alongside the rest of the platform: inference, agents, embeddings,
vector search, GPU compute, storage, and identity, on one host behind one key.

## Models
- enso — our frontier family. Three tiers: `enso-flash`, `enso`, `enso-ultra`.
- Zen — our open-weight family. `zen5`, `zen5-pro`, `zen5-coder`, `zen5-flash`
  for text and code; `zen-vl` for vision; `zen-image`, `zen-voice`, `zen-music`,
  `zen-video` for other modalities; `zen-embedding` and `zen-rerank` for
  retrieval; `zen-guard` for safety classification. Weights are published.
- Models from other labs are reachable on the same endpoint, with the same key,
  when a workflow needs a specific one.

## Products
- AI API — chat, embeddings, images, and reranking at api.hanzo.ai/v1
- Hanzo Dev — coding agent
- AI Studio — train, fine-tune, and deploy models
- Cloud Platform — managed AI infrastructure with GPU clusters
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) — open protocol for AI context management
- Agent frameworks for building autonomous systems
